title: Moderation
intro: Residents help moderate their neighborhoods. Decisions are logged and can be appealed.
empty: Nothing to review in this area.

apply.title: Become a neighborhood moderator
apply.rules: Requirements: account older than 14 days, at least 5 posts with no reports, and sufficient reputation. You moderate areas where you have already posted.
apply.notEligible: You do not meet the requirements yet.
apply.submit: Become a moderator for this area
apply.done: You are now a moderator for this area. Thank you!

decisions.title: Decisions about me
decisions.empty: There are no moderation decisions about you.
decisions.appealLabel: Explain why you think this decision was unfair (at least 10 characters)
decisions.appealSent: Appeal sent. Another moderator or an administrator will review it.
